filmhouse.title: I Want Your Sex
filmhouse.description: Cult legend Gregg Araki returns in full frontal, uninhibited style with a razor sharp erotic comedy that pushes all the right buttons! When wide eyed Elliot (Cooper Hoffman) lands a dream job assisting boundary pushing artist Erika Tracy (Olivia Wilde), he is plunged headfirst into a raunchy, neon-drenched playground of art, obsession, and dangerously messy workplace dynamics in this glossy and campy sex comedy. Sundance critics and audiences hailed "I Want Your Sex" as a "hilarious, horny, and unapologetic cure for a sexless generation" In English Rated R21 for Mature Theme and Sexual Scenes

filmhouse.title: Girls Like Girls
filmhouse.description: The film title rings a bell? You're probably thinking of that 2015 anthem with the iconic music video that became a touchstone for a generation of queer women. Ten years on, Hayley Kiyoko, affectionately dubbed the "Lesbian Jesus" by fans, brings her beloved song to the big screen in her feature directorial debut! Set over one unforgettable, sun-soaked summer, Girls Like Girls follows Coley, the new girl in town, as she experiences the exhilaration, uncertainty, and vulnerability of first love while learning to embrace who she truly is. Starring Maya da Costa, Myra Molloy, and Zach Braff, the film is a heartfelt coming-of-age story about self-discovery, friendship, and the courage to choose yourself. To celebrate the film's Singapore exclusive release at Filmhouse, we're so excited to present a virtual Q&A with Hayley Kiyoko herself after the Fri 7 Aug, 8.30pm premiere , moderated by local artist and beloved queer icon Jean Seizure. Join us for an intimate conversation about bringing an internet-era cultural phenomenon to the screen, queer storytelling, and Kiyoko's journey from musician to filmmaker. In English Rated R21 for Homosexual Content.

filmhouse.title: Silent Friend
filmhouse.description: On the grounds of a medieval German university town looms an imposing Ginkgo biloba, a tree whose longevity stands in marked contrast to three intimate, human-scaled stories. In 1908, the university’s first female student gains admission into the prestigious botany department, confronting the sexism of both professors and peers. In 1972, amidst counterculture movements, a reserved student finds his attention captured by a fellow housemate and the geranium plant she studies. In 2020, during the COVID-19 pandemic, a neuroscientist from Hong Kong secures the help of a renowned botanist for an experiment on the old ginkgo tree. In German, Cantonese and English with English subitles. Rated M18 for Some Nudity and Drug Use.

filmhouse.title: The Invite
filmhouse.description: You’re cordially invited to the most chaotic dinner of the year. Fresh from its buzz heavy Sundance debut, Olivia Wilde’s razor sharp relationship comedy hits right where it hurts. Joe (Seth Rogen) and Angela (Wilde) are stuck in a domestic rut, made worse by the aggressively loud, boundary pushing love life of their upstairs neighbors, Hawk (Edward Norton) and Pina (Penélope Cruz). Hoping to smooth things over, Angela invites them down for a casual dinner party. But as the wine flows, polite small talk is instantly traded for a chaotic, hilariously uncomfortable truth game where social etiquette completely crumbles. In English Rated M18 for Mature Content and Coarse Language.

filmhouse.title: The World of Love
filmhouse.description: This touching drama tells the story of Jooin, an enigmatic 17-year-old high school student. She is a cheerful friend, a shameless daughter, a mischievous girlfriend, and a person who is always hard to predict. One day, after a fellow classmate asks Jooin to sign a petition to prevent a newly released sex offender from moving into their neighbourhood, Jooin refuses, causing a major scene. She starts to receive anonymous notes questioning her behavior, and cracks begin to appear in her formerly peaceful world. Join us on 2 and 3 July for an in-person Q&A with Director Yoon Ga-Eun. "I even felt professional jealousy." — Bong Joon-ho on THE WORLD OF LOVE In Korean with English subtitles. Rated PG13 for Some Sexual References. TW: Themes of Sexual Assault Toronto International Film Festival 2025 - World Premiere 9th Pingyao International Film Festival 2025 - Jury Award & People's Choice Award for Best Film BFI London Film Festival 2025 - Competition

filmhouse.title: Trainspotting (4K Restoration)
filmhouse.description: Danny Boyle's decade-defining adaptation of Irvine Welsh's Trainspotting celebrates its 30th anniversary in 2026, and is heading back to Filmhouse from 21 August in a 4K restoration as part of our Music In Film showcase! Ewan McGregor stars as Mark Renton, the most reflective member of a group that also includes the compulsive womaniser, Sick Boy (Jonny Lee Miller), and the hapless Spud (Ewen Bremner). Renton, Spud and Sick Boy's issues with drugs alternatively irritate and amuse their friend, Begbie (Robert Carlyle), a periodic psychopath whose outbursts of violence are one of the many factors that convince Renton to leave for London in the hope of starting a new life. Renton enjoys some success remoulding himself as an estate agent in the English capital, but it isn't long before his Edinburgh friends catch up with him. Begbie and co. need the money Renton has saved from his job to finance the drug deal that could make them all rich... In English. Rated R21 for Drug Use and Sexual Scenes

filmhouse.title: Oldboy - 4K Restoration
filmhouse.description: Long before Parasite and Squid Game hijacked global pop culture, Park Chan-wook’s operatic, Cannes-winning masterpiece completely redefined what a thriller could be. Don't miss out this re-release of the 4k restoration, for a limited time only! Oh Dae-su is abruptly kidnapped off the street and locked in a windowless hotel room for 15 years with no explanation. Just as suddenly, he is released, given a suit, a cell phone, and exactly five days to figure out who ruined his life and why. What follows is a pitch-black, hyper violent journey to the absolute brink of psychological vengeance. In Korean with English subtitles. Rated R21 for Mature Themes. TW: Contains themes of Sexual Violence.

filmhouse.title: How Can This Be Allow?!
filmhouse.description: A curated selection of Singapore Shorts by Objectifs Centre for Photography and Film. Scratch the surface of the clean and green, and something else stirs. How Can This Be Allow?! reveals a Singapore that doesn't make it into the tourism brochure: desire, repression, and the people who slip through the cracks of a spotless national image. A collision of shorts that shows an alternative side to what we call home. This programme is rated M18 . Presented in collaboration with Objectifs How Can This Be Allow?! will feature the following short films: To Kill The Birds and the Bees by Dir. Calleen Koh 11 min | 2021 | M18 To Kill the Birds & the Bees follows three separate stories of four average Singaporeans – a pair of young twins, a secondary school prefect and a conservative housewife – who each encounter a sexual situation in the course of their day. Someday My Prince Will Come by Dir. Ezzam Rahman 5 min | 2011 | PG Someday my Prince will come – is an experimental video art made in 2011. “Good things come to those who wait” – it is about what lies around the corner, the anticipation of it all, the waiting for something to happen. This video artwork is a depiction of what revolves around themes of yearning, longing, and quiet hope. Ezzam turns his lens towards the complexities of queer desire, particularly the often-isolating journey of seeking connection and companionship. A poignant symbol of vulnerability and tenderness, set against the backdrop of a world increasingly shaped by the unattainable ideals of social-media perfect bodies, flawless skin, curated lifestyles. This video artwork is both a quiet confession and a gentle resistance: a soft, lingering echo of desire in an image-saturated age. Gourmet Baby by Dir. Sandi Tan 15 min | 2001 | PG An idiosyncratic inter-generational relationship plays out across the dining table. A lonely, middle-aged bachelor finds in his niece the perfect dining companion and indulges her in fine dining experiences designed to refine her tastes. However, no amount of fine dining can stop his protégé’s exertion of individuality. Gunkworld by Dir. Mark Chee 10 min | 2020 | NC16 Gunkman, Sallysweets and Roboji are a gang of alien-monster students who terrorise their class with horrifying antics. As Gunkman’s mind-controlling powers escalate beyond the confines of the classroom, no one in the world is safe! I Can’t Sleep Tonight by Dir. K.Rajagopal 9 min | 1995 | PG13 I can't sleep tonight is a tale of three illegal foreigners who meet in Little India one night together unexpectedly not realizing how much they have in common sighnight by Dir. Jake Low 12 min | 2024 | M18 A family that appears ordinary on the surface grapples with the weight of expectations, secrets, and the haunting echoes of cultural traditions during a reunion dinner. "sighnight" is an exploration of the lengths to which individuals will go to preserve familial honour. It is a story of survival, control, and the bonds that tether us to our roots, even as we strive to break free.

filmhouse.title: On Body and Soul
filmhouse.description: Before diving into Ildikó Enyedi’s latest work, Silent Friend , revisit the Hungarian master’s Berlinale Golden Bear winning masterpiece that captivated audiences worldwide. Set against the backdrop of a stark Budapest slaughterhouse, two socially awkward co-workers discover they’ve been sharing the exact same dream every night, where they transform into two deer quietly falling in love in a snowy forest. Bizarre, tender, darkly funny, and poetic, On Body and Soul is one of the most uniquely arresting love stories modern European cinema has ever produced. Don't miss this rare big screen pairing! In Hungarian with English subtitles. Rated M18 for Sexual Scenes TW: Contains scenes depicting self-harm and animal cruelty.

filmhouse.title: Dear You & TEDxSingapore
filmhouse.description: TEDxSingapore and Filmhouse present a screening of Dear You in Teochew, featuring a live conversation with Opera Tang and Ah Ma. Who are you still waiting to hear back from? Legacy is usually something we sort out afterwards. We go through the drawers, trying to piece together what they meant, and carry forward a version we are guessing. Together with Filmhouse, we are inviting you, our community to book two seats. Bring your Ah Ma, your Ah Gong, your mother, whoever you have been meaning to ask something. Come join Opera Tang and her Ah Ma, and have that conversation in the present tense. --- Xiaowei travels to Thailand to find his "billionaire grandfather" who is out of contact due to debt problems, but unexpectedly find the one who has been corresponding with his grandmother for years is not her husband. In Teochew with English and Chinese subtitles. corresponding Rated PG13 for Some Coarse Language. Teochew Cultural Movie Showcase: DEAR YOU

filmhouse.description: The film title rings a bell? You're probably thinking of that 2015 anthem with the iconic music video that became a touchstone for a generation of queer women. Ten years on, Hayley Kiyoko, affectionately dubbed the "Lesbian Jesus" by fans, brings her beloved song to the big screen in her feature directorial debut! Set over one unforgettable, sun-soaked summer, Girls Like Girls follows Coley, the new girl in town, as she experiences the exhilaration, uncertainty, and vulnerability of first love while learning to embrace who she truly is. Starring Maya da Costa, Myra Molloy, and Zach Braff, the film is a heartfelt coming-of-age story about self-discovery, friendship, and the courage to choose yourself. To celebrate the film's Singapore exclusive release at Filmhouse, we're so excited to present a virtual Q&A with Hayley Kiyoko herself after the Fri 7 Aug, 8.30pm premiere , moderated by local artist and beloved queer icon Jean Seizure. Join us for an intimate conversation about bringing an internet-era cultural phenomenon to the screen, queer storytelling, and Kiyoko's journey from musician to filmmaker. In English Rated R21 for Homosexual Content.

filmhouse.title: The Invite
filmhouse.description: You’re cordially invited to the most chaotic dinner of the year. Fresh from its buzz heavy Sundance debut, Olivia Wilde’s razor sharp relationship comedy hits right where it hurts. Joe (Seth Rogen) and Angela (Wilde) are stuck in a domestic rut, made worse by the aggressively loud, boundary pushing love life of their upstairs neighbors, Hawk (Edward Norton) and Pina (Penélope Cruz). Hoping to smooth things over, Angela invites them down for a casual dinner party. But as the wine flows, polite small talk is instantly traded for a chaotic, hilariously uncomfortable truth game where social etiquette completely crumbles. In English Rated M18 for Mature Content and Coarse Language.

upcoming.title: Above and Below
upcoming.description: Friends embark on a dream vacation of parties and diving, but their trip takes a terrifying turn when criminals attack them at sea.

upcoming.title: Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island (Jpn)
upcoming.description: One day, while Chiikawa and Hachiware are relaxing in the plaza, Usagi suddenly arrives with a flyer slapped onto Usagi's face. Checking the flyer, Hachiware discovers it is an invitation with the words: "An Invitation to a Special Island." Lured by the tempting words on the flyer, Chiikawa and friends decide to join the island training camp. Boarding the ship alongside Rakko, who remains suspicious of the flyer's claims, the group sets foot on the island and receives a grand, warm welcome from the Island residents.

upcoming.title: Insidious: Out Of The Further
upcoming.description:
Having earned over $740 million at the global box office, the
Insidious franchise returns with a new family and a terror that redefines what
The Further is capable of. In Insidious: Out of the Further, Amelia Eve stars as
Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in
who discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost
souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. When something evil comes after
her, Gemma discovers an ability that changes everything: she doesn’t just
enter The Further, she can bring what lives there back to the real world.
Once the demons realize her power, our world becomes their playground.

upcoming.title: Khalifa (MAL)
upcoming.description: A man becomes entangled in a complex world of revenge, heritage, and influence amid gold smuggling.

upcoming.title: OK! Madam: Bon Voyage (KOR)
upcoming.description: Six years after the Hawaii airplane hijacking, Mi-yeong (UHM Jung-hwa) finds herself struggling with her rebellious teenage daughter, Nari, and her unemployed husband, Seok-hwan (PARK Sung-woong). When Hyun-min, a flight attendant she met during the hijacking, invites her family to his wedding aboard a luxury cruise ship, Mi-yeong eagerly proposes a family holiday. Met with indifference from her husband and daughter, she decides to embark alone, joining Hyun-min’s family and Ji-hoon (RYEO-UN), a charming magician. However, on the eve of the wedding, the celebration turns deadly when armed assailants seize the ship. After Seok-hwan and Nari are kidnapped and brought aboard, Mi-yeong discovers that she is the target of a much larger plot…

upcoming.title: Sunny Dancer
upcoming.description: As if conquering cancer wasn't hard enough, 17-year-old Ivy's parents sign her up to spend her summer at what she calls "chemo camp", where she manages to find unexpected friends in a group of misfits and has a summer she'll never forget.

upcoming.title: We Are All Strangers (Local)
upcoming.description: In contemporary Singapore, 21-year-old Junyang lives in the ease of youth while his father struggles to hold their modest life together. When Junyang’s relationship with his girlfriend takes an unexpected and life-altering turn, the young couple is forced to face the realities of adulthood far sooner than anticipated. At the same time, an exuberant woman enters his father’s life and heart, quietly reshaping the fragile balance between father and son.  As both generations confront love, loss, and responsibility, they must redefine what family means – and learn to live with the imperfect bonds between those we are born to and those we choose.

upcoming.title: Toxic - A Fairy Tale For Grown Ups (KAN)
upcoming.description: Set in a bygone era, this gripping tale unfolds in the coastal paradise of Goa, where a powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches and vibrant culture.

upcoming.title: All Wishes Come True! (M)
upcoming.description: On a wondrous island where mortals and Immortals dwell as one, a legendary vault holds a fortune beyond dreaming. Lü Dongbin and Zhongli Quan have a plan. To crack that vault, these two mortals will pull off the impossible: pose as Immortals themselves. They gather six more misfits along the way: He Xiangu, Tieguai Li, Han Xiangzi, Cao Guojiu, Lan Caihe, and Zhang Guolao. Eight ordinary souls, one extraordinary heist, and death waiting for anyone caught trying to outsmart the heavens.

upcoming.title: The Dog Stars
upcoming.description: The film tells the story of Hig (Jacob Elordi), a young pilot who, together with a military survivalist, Bangley (Josh Brolin), has carved out an efficient but isolated homestead in a brutal post-apocalyptic world. But when Hig receives a mysterious radio transmission, he ventures into the unknown in search of the hope and humanity he still believes exist.

upcoming.title: Tony
upcoming.description: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

upcoming.title: On Her Majesty’s Secret Service (1969) (4K)
upcoming.description: James Bond is assigned a mission to defeat Blofeld, who hypnotises beautiful women to realise his own evil motives. Meanwhile, Bond also falls in love with a crime lord's daughter.

upcoming.title: Tad And The Magic Lamp
upcoming.description: Tad, his girlfriend Sara and their friends Momia, Jeff and Belzoni embark on an adventure after Tadeo accidentally unleashes an ancient spell.

upcoming.title: Hope (KOR)
upcoming.description: Reinforcements have been diverted to battle wildfires and all communication has been cut off. Hope’s police outpost chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae struggle to defend a village of the elderly, while in the mountains, Sung-ki and the locals who set out to track the beast find themselves hunted instead. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

upcoming.title: Idiots
upcoming.description: Two rock-bottom drivers transport a wealthy teen to rehab, but their simple job spirals into a chaotic journey of drugs, danger, and crime as their passenger derails their plans.

upcoming.title: Resident Evil
upcoming.description:
From the mind of visionary filmmaker Zach Cregger
(Weapons, Barbarian) comes a thrilling —and terrifying —
reinvention of the Resident Evil franchise. In an all-new story,
Resident Evil follows Bryan (Austin Abrams), a medical courier who
unwittingly finds himself in an action-packed, non-stop race for
survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in
chaos.

upcoming.title: The Transformers The Movie 40th Anniversary
upcoming.description: Forty years later, it still hits like a truck. Experience THE TRANSFORMERS: THE MOVIE back on the big screen in 4K and relive the battle, the music and THE moment fans never forgot. Stay through the credits...as this journey ends, a new one begins.

upcoming.title: The Uprising
upcoming.description: Andrew Garfield stars as the legendary leader of a ferocious rebellion against the tyranny of King Richard II. As war burns across England, he forms an army of the people to face the King's might in a fight for justice and survival.

upcoming.title: Everybody Dig Bill Evans
upcoming.description: Legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans forms his perfect trio, recording two groundbreaking albums. When his brilliant young bassist dies tragically, Evans is devastated. The story follows Evans' journey to overcome grief and return to music.

upcoming.title: Forgotten Island
upcoming.description: Your best friendship is worth fighting for. DreamWorks Animation, the studio that brought you unforgettable bonds between a boy and a dragon in How to Train Your Dragon, an ogre and a donkey in Shrek, and a robot and a gosling in The Wild Robot, now welcomes a dazzling and emotional story about two lifelong best friends who must come together before they drift apart in Forgotten Island.

upcoming.title: Heart of the Beast
upcoming.description: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont (Brad Pitt) and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements. From acclaimed filmmaker David Ayer, Heart of the Beast is an intense adventure thriller that explores the unbreakable bond between a man and his best friend as they face their greatest battle yet.

upcoming.title: Digger
upcoming.description: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity’s savior before the disaster he’s unleashed destroys everything.

upcoming.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
upcoming.description: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

upcoming.title: Verity
upcoming.description:
Adapted from Colleen Hoover's best-selling novel, this seductive,
psychological thriller follows renowned author Verity Crawford (Anne
Hathaway) and Lowen Ashleigh (Dakota Johnson), a struggling writer who
relocates to the remote Crawford estate to ghostwrite for Verity. After Lowen
uncovers what appears to be Verity's chilling autobiographical notes, she
wrestles with the disturbing and twisted confessions about Verity’s husband
Jeremy (Josh Hartnett), and finds it hard to separate fiction from reality,
manipulation from attraction, and opportunity from obsession.

upcoming.title: Other Mommy
upcoming.description: From producer James Wan, one of the most influential architects of modern horror, and Blumhouse Atomic Monster, the studio behind Backrooms and Obsession, comes a terrifying trip from breakout genre director Rob Savage, into the darkening world of a young girl, Bela, who forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home who looks uncannily like her own mother.

upcoming.title: The Sandbox (Local)
upcoming.description: When an online rumour starts that Marvel is looking to cast its next big superhero out of Singapore, Sandbox, a struggling stunt training school, is suddenly inundated with hopeless wannabes hoping to become movie stars. With only a week to make them look good, can the Sandbox team turn these zeroes into heroes… and maybe save themselves in the process?

upcoming.title: The Social Reckoning
upcoming.description: A companion piece to the hit film The Social Network, Sorkin’s original screenplay is based on the events that gave rise to the Wall Street Journal’s shocking exposé The Facebook Files. The film is inspired by the true story of how Frances Haugen (Madison), a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz (White), a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network’s most guarded secrets.

upcoming.title: Street Fighter
upcoming.description: Street Fighters Ryu and Ken reunite when Chun-Li recruits them for the World Warrior Tournament. As they face a hidden conspiracy, they must confront each other and their past-or face destruction.

upcoming.title: Whalefall
upcoming.description: Following the death of his father (Josh Brolin), Jay Gardiner (Austin Abrams) goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.

upcoming.title: Clayface
upcoming.description: DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain. It unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.

upcoming.title: Sense And Sensibility
upcoming.description: From Focus Features and Working Title comes an irresistible new take on Jane Austen’s iconic Sense and Sensibility: a charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood starring Daisy Edgar-Jones and Esmé Creed-Miles.

upcoming.title: The Weight
upcoming.description: Desperate to save what is left of his family, during the height of the Great Depression a battle-scarred veteran is hired to help smuggle a fortune in gold across 100 miles of impenetrable wilderness.

upcoming.title: The Cat in the Hat
upcoming.description: In the wonderfully whimsical tradition of Dr. Seuss, The Cat in the Hat comes to the big screen in his animated theatrical feature film debut, doing what he does best— spreading joy to “happyless” kids. In the film, The Cat takes on his toughest assignment yet… to cheer a pair of siblings struggling with their move to a new town.

upcoming.title: How To Rob A Bank
upcoming.description: Nicholas Hoult and Pete Davidson are part of a group of bank robbers who share their heists on social media in this tongue-in-cheek thriller from the director of Bullet Train.

upcoming.title: Disney's Hexed
upcoming.description: In Walt Disney Animation Studios' all-new magical coming-of-age saga, “Hexed,” an impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie (voice of Hailee Steinfeld) discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice (voice of Rashida Jones), they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.

upcoming.title: Focker In-Law
upcoming.description: The circle of trust just got bigger. This November, comedy icon and Emmy winner Ben Stiller and two-time Oscar winner Robert De Niro reunite, joined by Grammy winner and Oscar nominee Ariana Grande, in Focker-In-Law, a new chapter in the blockbuster Meet the Parents franchise.

upcoming.title: Violent Night 2
upcoming.description: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he'll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Kristen Bell).

upcoming.title: Dune: Part Three
upcoming.description: Dune: Part Three is based on the novel Dune Messiah by Frank Herbert and delivers the epic conclusion to Villeneuve’s trilogy.

upcoming.title: Marvel Studios' Avengers: Doomsday
upcoming.description: Heroes from three different worlds must unite when they're thrust together to confront a catastrophic danger that could destroy everything they know.

upcoming.title: Jumanji: Open World
upcoming.description: The players have escaped the ever-changing jungles of Jumanji, but this time the game breaks free of its console, unleashing chaos into our world.

upcoming.title: The Angry Birds Movie 3
upcoming.description: Red faces his greatest challenge yet, which is being a dad - and also saving the world.

upcoming.title: Disney and Pixar's Gatto
upcoming.description: In Disney and Pixar's “Gatto,” the scrappy black cat Nero begins to question whether he’s lived the right lives after years of maneuvering the canal-ridden, superstitious city of Venice, Italy. Indebted to Rocco, the ruthless local feline mob boss, Nero finds himself in a quandary and is forced to forge a truly unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose - unless Venice gets the better of him first.

upcoming.description: In a post-apocalyptic world, a virus wipes out humanity. Survivors face roaming scavengers called Reapers. Protagonist Hig, a pilot, survived the flu but lost his wife
